claims.statement: Tom Allen of St. Louis was named as one of Jem Mace's seconds for the Mace-Coburn fight near New Orleans.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen of St. Lous, and Jimmy Cusick see- ond Mace

notes: Dispatch datelined New Orleans, November 29, for a fight set for November 30. The hint about Allen being in New Orleans is not stated and is dropped.
